source.name: civicAPI
source.note: Counts from secretaries of state; calls by civicAPI's decision desk

method: The frozen forecast of record, updated only for the races called so far: each call shifts the errors races share (national, regional, state), and the races still out follow. Partial vote counts are not used.
held_note: A seat changes hands when its winner's party differs from the party holding it now: House seats by district number (the Clerk of the House's member list; a vacant seat counts for its last member's party), Senate seats and governorships by incumbent.

source.name: 270toWin, "Poll Closing Times"
source.note: latest closing time in each state and time zone; individual polling places may close earlier
